# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He shed tears from his eyes while delivering his emotional farewell address to his class.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is a lenient yet harsh and ineffective disciplinarian who maintains disgraceful order in his classroom while frequently hitting his students. He ignores younger children in favor of older pupils preparing for examinations, often acting with spite, sarcasm, and self-righteous gravity. He also demonstrates a touch of romance and imagination when courting.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon taught at Brierley school, where he focused his efforts primarily on older students preparing for the Regent's exams while neglecting the younger children. He spent much of his time during class instructing and paying attention to Sukey Pullen, whom he also visited at home almost every evening under the guise of helping with schoolwork. During school outings, he gathered Mayflowers and gave them to Sukey. In the classroom, he severely disciplined students such as Nell Harcourt by forcing her to stand before the blackboard or sit beside male classmates, and publicly mocked pupils' spelling and geometry skills. Despite his harshness and poor discipline, his departing speech brought his students to tears before he left his post.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
